scope: Historical home-shirt crest references for the audited Premier team-seasons, 1992/93–2025/26. Not a reconstruction of every embroidery, away-kit or match-specific variation.

club_notes.arsenal: Uses the recorded shirt reference: the commercial 2001 redraw was not worn on shirts. The 2005 farewell and 2011 anniversary versions are limited to those seasons. The 2024/25 cannon is confirmed by the official adidas launch; the 2002 shield returns in 2025/26.
club_notes.astonvilla: Uses HFK reference artwork for the 1992 identity; small production/embroidery variations are not separately reconstructed.
club_notes.barnsley: Only 1997/98 is in the audited Premier catalogue; uses the pre-2002 reference.
club_notes.brentford: First Premier season is 2021/22; earlier mid-season 1995 changes are outside this catalogue.
club_notes.charlton: The HFK 1983 artwork represents the three-colour design preferred again from 1991.
club_notes.huddersfield: 2018/19 uses the terrier worn on the shirt, not the heraldic corporate identity retained in official documents.
club_notes.ipswich: Only 1992-94, 2000-01 and 2024-25 start years occur in this catalogue.
club_notes.mancity: The 1994 shop-only centenary design is excluded. The 2012 monochrome shirt reference is limited to 2012/13.
club_notes.manunited: The 1993 date follows the article text; the artwork alt text says 1995. The European-only 1997 variant is excluded from league seasons.
club_notes.newcastle: 2017 anniversary and 2019 monochrome shirt references are each limited to one season.
club_notes.portsmouth: The 2008 design continues into 2009/10, confirmed against the source shirt illustration; it is not a one-season anniversary badge.
club_notes.tottenham: The 1997 coat of arms is restored to the 1983 design in 1999. The 2007 and 2017 shirt variants last one season.
club_notes.watford: The 1991 centenary is excluded from later years. The 2006/07 125th-anniversary version lasts one season; the standard 1979 hart is restored.
club_notes.westham: 1995, 2015 and 2020 commemorative references do not persist after their season.
club_notes.wimbledon: Original Wimbledon FC, not AFC Wimbledon or Milton Keynes Dons.
club_notes.hull: The 2004 centenary reference is not carried into later seasons. The standard 2001 badge covers the 2008, 2009 and 2013 Premier entries.
club_notes.southampton: The 1985 centenary is excluded from 1992–1994; those seasons use the standard 1974 reference.
club_notes.qpr: The 1983 reference artwork includes Loftus Road and 1982 Division Two Champions on the scroll. HFK documents differing scroll embroideries, often blank. This is a crest design reference, not an exact reconstruction of each season’s embroidery.

arsenal-2024.reference: Arsenal cannon identity; 2024/25 home-kit use confirmed by adidas. Glyph reference, not a reconstruction of white-thread embroidery.
arsenal-2024.rights: Arsenal FC trademark artwork; editorial identity reference, not freely licensed artwork.
